_about: Charles Rann Kennedy (1808-1867), barrister and classical scholar, translator of Demosthenes for Bohn: Specimens of Greek and Latin Verse, chiefly translations (London: Henry G. Bohn, 1853), English poems (Byron, Milton, Shakespeare and others) rendered into Greek and Latin verse, raw IA. Greek-heavy OCR (clean ratio 0.80), kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling; a candidate for the later Greek re-OCR batch. His Demosthenes is on the demosthenes shelf and his Virgil on the virgil shelf.
